Lily had almost forgotten about the lottery ticket she’d bought just for fun. Feeling curious, she decided to check the winning numbers, even though she didn’t expect much. As she looked at the numbers on the screen, her heart started to race. One by one, each number on her ticket matched. She could hardly believe her eyes... she had ACTUALLY won!

For a moment, she just sat there, staring at the ticket in shock, her hands shaking. This can’t be real, she thought. But it was. She was a millionaire. Ideas started to race through her mind. What should I buy first? A new car? Maybe a bigger place to live? She checked the numbers again, unable to believe her luck. But there it was, clear as day: Lily had really won the lottery.
